data.name: Sharwalila
data.gender_notes: Sharwalila is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharva', meaning 'graceful' and 'sweet' and 'lila', meaning 'play' or 'pastime'. The name Sharwalila signifies the graceful and beautiful play of the divine. The name Sharwalila carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharwalila usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the divine grace and beauty that surrounds us all.
data.etymology: Sharwalila belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwalila total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
